text:
olga_csm: Hi team — Heliotrope filed a formal onboarding request. They want an 8B reranker (low-latency) + 65B long-context summarizer (10k token windows) in a Private deployment on GCP eu-west4. Must integrate with customer-managed GCP KMS and enforce no-pii retention. They also asked for streaming summaries and a live-fallback policy. Need intake owner and brief feasibility note.
ryan_ml_eng: Quick sanity: 8B reranker at int8 should be fine for low latency. 65B with 10k context is the tricky one — we'll need attention slicing / flash attention + NVMe KV cache or model sharding across GPUs. Do we have target qps numbers?
olga_csm: Customer said peak reranker qps ~220 during business hours, summarizer ~30 concurrent long jobs. Renewal at month 4 will be high-risk if p95 >900ms for reranker or summaries have latency >5s. They also care about token-cost per 1k before renewal.
infra_lee: From infra: we can provision a Private VPC in eu-west4 and attach Private Service Connect endpoints. For KMS: customer wants us to use their CMEK via GCP KMS; we'll need a service account with kms.cryptoKeyVersions.use permission. Also need clarification on whether model artifacts stay in their bucket or ours.
sam_security: Security checklist: 1) Customer-managed KMS for model keys + signed model artifacts. 2) No request bodies persisted (only hashed IDs and telemetry). 3) Enforce egress rules to eu-west4. 4) Provide attestation for key access and rotate keys on schedule. Also want an option for client-side redaction.
legal_jas: I'll kick off a short privacy addendum draft to cover PII/PHI handling, retention windows, and incident notification. Please flag if they process PHI.
devex_maya: For enablement: I'll assemble a 20-minute demo + quickstart SDK and a sample redaction script. Ask Heliotrope to upload a 50-doc eval corpus and expected labels for ROUGE/F1 checks. Also propose a 30-minute tech walkthrough once infra creds are ready.
ryan_ml_eng: Proposed technical plan: - Benchmark 8B reranker int8 with 128 token context for 220 qps target - Prototype 65B long-context on 4xA100 with nvme backing for KV cache and test 10k context streaming - Routing: reranker low-latency fast-path, summarizer batched and streaming path - Canary: start reranker at 10 qps for 48h, summarizer 2 concurrent sessions for 72h, measure p50/p95 and token costs
olga_csm: They uploaded sample transcripts to shared intake bucket and noted some docs contain customer emails and order IDs (PII). They said they prefer pre-ingest redaction but may allow in-VPC redaction if needed.
sam_security: Two options: client-side de-id (preferred) or a redaction Lambda inside their VPC that writes de-identified blobs to the model input bucket. If we run redaction, need delete-after-processing SLA and audit logs.
infra_lee: Action items from infra: request service account with KMS permissions, bucket ACL for model artifacts, and shared VPC peering info. We'll prepare a runbook for network ACLs and failover.
devex_maya: SDK example (in-VPC private endpoint):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-eu-west4.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"reranker-8b-int8","input":"<conversation snippet>"}'
```
Also will prepare streaming example next.
deploy-bot: Onboarding checklist created: [ ] intake validated, [ ] infra creds received, [ ] KMS key access provisioned, [ ] model artifact access confirmed, [ ] redaction approach chosen, [ ] canary config created, [ ] observability dashboards wired. See ops ticket /ops/onboard/2798880001
ryan_ml_eng: Owners: I'll take benchmarks + canary design; infra_lee owns KMS + VPC; sam_security owns PII controls; devex_maya owns runbook and SDK. olga_csm will coordinate customer comms and calendar.
olga_csm: Proposed timeline: security/legal signoff by day 2, infra + KMS access by day 7, bench + prototype by day 10, canary start day 12. Customer requested a pre-renewal report at month 3 with cost estimates and quality metrics.
legal_jas: Noted. I'll prepare the addendum draft and circulate to olga_csm for customer review.
sam_security: If canary shows p95 >900ms for reranker, flag as renewal risk and present mitigation options (tune batching, increase GPU nodes, or alternative quantization).
devex_maya: I'll post the quickstart repo link and schedule the walkthrough once infra access is confirmed.
olga_csm: Thanks all — scheduling kickoff for tomorrow 10:00 CET and adding Heliotrope contacts. Will update thread after the call. :calendar:
